AboutUsSection.heading: Reliable

paragraphs.first: Global Technology Innovations has been operating in construction since 2009 and provides comprehensive solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial facilities.
paragraphs.second: The company began as a family construction business and over the years grew into a stable professional structure.
paragraphs.third: We combine the practical experience of the previous generation, modern technologies, and a responsible approach to every project, ensuring quality, safety, and stable results.

AboutUsSection.imageAlt: Global Technology Innovations team members with blueprints

items.question: How does the cooperation process with a client work?
items.answer: We start with a free consultation to determine the client’s needs. Then, we prepare a cost estimate, agree on timelines, and sign a contract. After that, we begin project implementation with regular progress reports.

items.question: Can you purchase materials on your own?
items.answer: Yes, we can fully handle the procurement and delivery of materials. This saves you time and ensures all materials meet the project’s technical requirements.

items.question: Do you only do renovations, or new construction as well?
items.answer: We provide the full range of construction services — from major renovations to new builds, including concrete works, masonry, facades, roofing, interior finishes, and more.

items.question: Can I order a turnkey apartment with furniture?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a turnkey service that includes all construction and finishing works, material procurement, and even complete furnishing of the premises.

items.question: What are the project completion times?
items.answer: The duration depends on the scope of the project. A small renovation may take a few weeks, while a full-scale construction may take several months. We always agree on timelines before starting and stick to the schedule.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Global Technology Innovations s. r. o., ID: 57 066 566, located at Jenisejská 45A, 040 12 Košice-Nad Jazerom (hereinafter 'Company', 'we'), processes personal data of website visitors innovations.sk in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

1.title: 1. Who we are and contacts
1.text:
Data Controller: Global Technology Innovations s. r. o.
Address: Jenisejská 45A, 040 12 Košice-Nad Jazerom
E-mail: info@global-technology-innovations.com
Phone: +421 917 896 18

2.title: 2. What data we collect
list: Form data (contact/estimate request/call order): name, e-mail, phone, message content and related metadata.
Candidate data (Career form): resume/portfolio, experience, contact details.
Technical data: IP address, browser type/version, language settings, pages, access time, cookies.
Analytics: anonymized visit statistics (e.g., Google Analytics, Plausible, etc.).

3.title: 3. Purpose and legal basis for processing
list: Responding to inquiries/estimates — contract performance or steps toward its conclusion (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), as well as our legitimate interest in effective communication (Art. 6(1)(f)).
Personnel recruitment — legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)); if we request additional data — by consent (Art. 6(1)(a)).
Analytics and site improvement — legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)); for marketing/non-essential cookies — consent (Art. 6(1)(a)).
Legal obligations — fulfillment of legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)).

4.title: 4. Cookies and analytics
4.text: We use essential cookies for site operation and analytical/marketing cookies with your consent. You can manage consent through the cookie banner or browser settings. See 'Cookie settings' section or separate Cookie Policy (if available) for details.

5.title: 5. Who we share data with
list: IT service providers (hosting, e-mail, CRM, analytics) acting as processors under processing agreements.
Partners/subcontractors if needed for estimate preparation or work execution (we provide only minimally necessary data).
Government agencies if required by law.

6.title: 6. International transfers
6.text: If data is transferred outside the EEA, we will ensure appropriate safeguards (e.g., EC Standard Contractual Clauses).

7.title: 7. Retention period
list: Form inquiries: up to 12 months or longer during active dialogue/contract.
Candidate data: up to 6 months (or longer with separate consent).
Contractual/accounting data: according to legal requirements (5-10 years depending on document type).
Analytics: according to service retention (e.g., 14-26 months).

8.title: 8. Your rights
8.text: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability, objection to processing, and withdrawal of consent without affecting the lawfulness of previous processing. Contact: info@global-technology-innovations.com.

9.title: 9. Complaints
9.text: You can also file a complaint with the supervisory authority — Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov SR (Slovak Republic).

10.title: 10. Security
10.text: We implement technical and organizational measures (TLS, access controls, logging) to protect data from unauthorized access.

11.title: 11. Children's data
11.text: The site is not intended for children under 16. If you believe a child has provided us with data, contact us for deletion.

12.title: 12. Changes to this policy
12.text: We may periodically update this Policy. The new version takes effect from the moment of publication on the Site.

paragraphs.second: Since 2009 we have been working in construction and have delivered hundreds of projects of different scale. This practical experience allows us to build teams of specialists that meet the real demands of modern construction sites.
